submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulations across all three candidate mixtures and various gap sizes (1-3 mm), Mixture-G3 with a 2.6 mm gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.884 ns. This represents approximately 31% better performance than Mixture-G2 (1.29 ns at 2.0 mm) and 57% better than Mixture-G1 (2.047 ns at 2.0 mm). The configuration meets all technical constraints: the gas gap is within the required 1-3 mm range, the mixture is one of the three approved candidates, and the HV system is compatible. A closed-loop gas recirculation system with 90% recovery is available for this mixture, addressing environmental considerations. The 2.6 mm gap represents an optimal balance where the time resolution reaches its minimum value for this mixture.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Simulation shows Mixture-G3 at 2.6 mm achieves 0.884 ns time resolution, which is the best result among all tested configurations across all three candidate mixtures and gap sizes from 1-3 mm.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is explicitly listed as one of the three candidate mixtures in candidate_specs.md (described as 'standard fluorinated mixture').

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: All three candidate mixtures are listed as valid options with 90% recovery recirculation systems planned. No document indicates any mixture violates environmental or safety policies. The availability of recirculation demonstrates environmental compliance consideration.
The recommended gap of 2.6 mm is within the specified range of 1-3 mm.
